title: FBI-UAP-D013, Washington State ‘UFO’ Investigation, 1952-1960
doc_notes: This document is an FBI file containing various reports of UAP sightings and encounters in Washington State between 1952 and 1960; encounter content is present.

encounters.summary: Witness observed a large, silver, parachute-like object high above the Sand Point Naval Air Station that moved away to the North after two minutes.
Witness observed a bright, shimmering object at extreme altitude that darted off to the West and disappeared, leaving a vaporous ring.
encounters.entity_appearance: bright shimmering speck with four blue vaporous rings
encounters.quote: It moved at incredible speed towards the eastern horizon in about 10 seconds.

encounters.summary: Witness observed a metallic object in the sky with a metallic luster, estimated at 10 to 15 feet in diameter, hovering for 15 minutes.
Police officer observed a large, shiny, spherical metal ball, 30 feet in diameter, hovering at low altitude before taking off at high speed.
encounters.entity_behavior: hovered with chugging engine sound, then accelerated rapidly
encounters.quote: I could hear the 'chug chug' of the engines sounding like a tractor engine.

encounters.summary: Witness observed a man in a neat suit on the beach carrying a coil of rope, accompanied by bright flashes.
encounters.entity_appearance: white male, tall, over 6 feet, strong, about 30 years old
